text: dsh-pdfslim 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 PDF 处理插件，通过配置 MCP 客户端接入 api.pdfslim.app。它把云端服务提供的工具交给 DSH 使用，可将 PDF 压缩到目标大小或质量、执行无损结构优化，并检查页数、文件大小和密码保护状态。适合需要在 DSH 对话中处理 PDF 的用户。配置指向远程服务，处理文件时需将 PDF 内容发送给该服务；仓库配置中没有声明 API Key。

dsh-pdfslim connects DeepSeek Harness to api.pdfslim.app through MCP. Its tools compress PDFs to a target size or quality, optimize structure, and inspect page count, file size, and password protection. PDF content is sent to the service; no API key is declared in the repository configuration.

dsh-pdfslim 的功能「压缩与检查 PDF」：通过 MCP 工具压缩 PDF 到目标大小或质量、优化其结构，并查看页数、文件大小和密码保护状态。
dsh-pdfslim 使用前须知：PDF 处理请求会发送到 api.pdfslim.app 的远程 MCP 服务；配置里没有声明密钥项。（见 cordis.patch.yml:8-10）

dsh-pdfslim README · Install：```sh
git clone https://github.com/zhaoyaqi18/dsh-pdfslim
dsh plugin --profile <name> add ./dsh-pdfslim
dsh --profile <name>
```

The upstream MCP server is hosted and always-on — no local engine, no dependencies.

dsh-pdfslim README · Usage example：> "Compress this PDF to under 1MB: ./report.pdf"

The agent calls `mcp__pdfslim__compress_pdf` and returns the compressed file.

dsh-pdfslim README · Limits & pricing：- **Anonymous**: 20 free calls/day per IP — perfect for trying it out.
- **Pro Key**: $9.90/month, 5,000 calls, up to 100MB files — [buy on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/s/64ba154ebb).
- Files up to 100MB. Gigantic files (100MB+) are handled by the web app: [pdfslim.app](https://pdfslim.app).

When the free quota runs out, the API itself tells the AI where to go (buy a key or use the free web app) — no dead ends.

dsh-pdfslim README · Why PDF Slim?：- Real compression engine (MuPDF render-rebuild), not just re-packaging — measured **93%** on a 11MB test PDF.
- Privacy-first: files are processed in memory, not stored.
- Works from anywhere: Claude, Hermes, DSH, or any MCP client.
